title: What This Democrat’s Surge in Texas Says About the Midterms

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档聚焦设计之美及周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每天都要带上300件最珍爱的宝贝去工作，并把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个充满生活气息的快闪博物馆，摆满了美丽的50年历史藏品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: We are facing an almost existential crisis in this country because tech giants are having their way with us.
sentences.zh: 我们国家正面临一场近乎生存危机的困境，因为科技巨头正在对我们为所欲为。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro, and today I'm interviewing
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗，今天我采访的嘉宾是

sentences.en: Democratic candidate for Texas Governor Gina Hinojosa.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州长民主党候选人吉娜·伊诺霍萨。

sentences.en: I'm Gina Hinojosa.
sentences.zh: 我是吉娜·伊诺霍萨。

sentences.en: My pronouns are mom, Texan, and soon-to-be governor.
sentences.zh: 我的代词是妈妈、德州人和准州长。

sentences.en: Hinojosa, who is a state representative, and Greg Abbott, the Republican incumbent, appear to be in a dead heat.
sentences.zh: 身兼州众议员的伊诺霍萨与共和党现任州长格雷格·阿博特目前看来势均力敌。

sentences.en: If she wins, she'd be the first Latino person to ever hold the office and the first Democrat since the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 如果她获胜，她将成为该州历史上第一位拉丁裔州长，也是自20世纪90年代以来第一位胜出的民主党人。

sentences.en: If she loses, Abbott will head back for a historic fourth term.
sentences.zh: 如果她落败，阿博特将迎来历史性的第四个任期。

sentences.en: All eyes are on Texas during these midterms because Democrat James Tallarico and Republican Ken Paxton's race could determine control of the Senate.
sentences.zh: 在这次中期选举中，所有目光都聚焦德克萨斯州，因为民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科与共和党人肯·帕克斯顿的竞选可能会决定参议院的控制权。

sentences.en: But Democrats have tried and failed for years to gain a foothold in Texas.
sentences.zh: 但民主党多年来一直试图在德州站稳脚跟却屡屡失败。

sentences.en: So what makes Hinojosa think she can break the losing streak?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么让伊诺霍萨认为她能打破连败纪录呢？

sentences.en: And what is her argument to voters who may have supported Abbott in the past?
sentences.zh: 她对那些过去可能支持过阿博特的选民又有什么说辞呢？

sentences.en: We should say we reached out to Governor Abbott, who declined our request for an interview.
sentences.zh: 我们需要说明的是，我们曾联系阿博特州长，但他拒绝了我们的采访请求。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Representative Gina Hinojosa.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与吉娜·伊诺霍萨众议员的对话。

sentences.en: But first, a quick message.
sentences.zh: 但在此之前，先听一条简短的讯息。

sentences.en: If you're not a subscriber, we have some news for you.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，我们有个好消息告诉您。

sentences.en: You can now explore The Times for free without a paywall during your first month in The New York Times app.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App 的第一个月，您现在可以免费探索《纽约时报》而无需受到付费墙限制。

sentences.en: Just download the app, and we hope you enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 只需下载App，我们希望您会喜欢。

sentences.en: Now, on to the interview.
sentences.zh: 现在，进入采访环节。

sentences.en: Welcome, Gina Hinojosa, to the interview.
sentences.zh: 欢迎吉娜·伊诺霍萨来到访谈节目。

sentences.en: It's so great to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能邀请到你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，露露。

sentences.en: First day of early vote here in Texas.
sentences.zh: 今天是德州提前投票的第一天。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I saw you voted this morning.
sentences.zh: 我看到你今天早上投票了。

sentences.en: How was it?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Was it busy, enthusiastic?
sentences.zh: 人多吗，大家热情高涨吗？

sentences.en: What was the vibe?
sentences.zh: 现场氛围如何？

sentences.en: Yes, all of the above.
sentences.zh: 是的，以上种种都有。

sentences.en: We've hit several spots already here in Central Texas.
sentences.zh: 我们已经在德州中部走访了好几个地方。

sentences.en: And in fact, we just came from San Marcos, where we went to Texas State.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们刚从圣马科斯过来，去了德克萨斯州立大学。

sentences.en: And there were so many students who were excited about voting, heard great stories.
sentences.zh: 那里有那么多对投票感到兴奋的学生，我们听到了许多精彩的故事。

sentences.en: So yeah, people are pumped.
sentences.zh: 所以，大家都很兴奋。

sentences.en: Turnouts high across the state.
sentences.zh: 全州的投票率都很高。

sentences.en: I read that before you decided to run for governor, you were thinking of running for state comptroller, which is a slightly less visible role in the state.
sentences.zh: 我读到过，在决定竞选州长之前，你曾考虑竞选州主计长，这个职位在州内受关注度稍微低一点。

sentences.en: What was it like to see your name on the ballot for governor?
sentences.zh: 看到自己的名字出现在州长选票上是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It's almost surreal.
sentences.zh: 这几乎像是做梦一样。

sentences.en: I never planned to do this.
sentences.zh: 我从没计划过做这件事。

sentences.en: I never planned to run for anything.
sentences.zh: 我从未计划过竞选任何职位。

sentences.en: Really, I just try to mind my own business, Lulu, and somehow I've ended up running for governor.
sentences.zh: 说实话，露露，我只是想管好自己的事，但不知怎么的，我最后竟然成了州长候选人。

sentences.en: I started really on this path, on this journey, when I ran for school board, because they tried to shut down my son's school.
sentences.zh: 我踏上这条道路、这段旅程，其实是从竞选学区董事会开始的，因为他们试图关闭我儿子的学校。

sentences.en: My son, Mateo, was in kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 我儿子马特奥当时上幼儿园。

sentences.en: And he was at the most perfect school by our home.
sentences.zh: 他在我们家附近那所最完美的学校上学。

sentences.en: And when I learned they wanted to shut it down, I just got mad.
sentences.zh: 当我得知他们想关掉这所学校时，我气坏了。

sentences.en: And I ran for the school board.
sentences.zh: 于是我竞选了学区董事会。

sentences.en: And I won.
sentences.zh: 我赢了。

sentences.en: And it was part of a citywide community effort to save our schools.
sentences.zh: 这是拯救我们学校的全市社区努力的一部分。

sentences.en: And we did.
sentences.zh: 我们做到了。

sentences.en: But then I understood that the financial pressures to shut down our neighborhood schools were coming from the state.
sentences.zh: 但随后我明白，关闭我们社区学校的财政压力来自州政府。

sentences.en: The state takes more and more of our money and doesn't give it back to our schools.
sentences.zh: 州政府拿走了我们越来越多的资金，却没有回馈给我们的学校。

sentences.en: And so I ran for the Texas House.
sentences.zh: 所以我竞选了德克萨斯州众议员。

sentences.en: And that's where I've been for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我在那里工作了十年。

sentences.en: And my primary fight has been for public schools.
sentences.zh: 我主要的战斗一直是为公立学校而战。

sentences.en: Originally, you're right, I was going to run for comptroller because that's where the voucher program was going to be administered.
sentences.zh: 最初，你说得对，我是打算竞选主计长，因为学券计划将由该办公室管理。

sentences.en: School vouchers that take money from our public schools to give to private schools.
sentences.zh: 学券计划会把公立学校的资金抽走给私立学校。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, I'll fight vouchers at the comptroller's office.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，我会在主计长办公室与学券作斗争。

sentences.en: But nobody wanted to run against Greg Abbott.
sentences.zh: 但没有人愿意与格雷格·阿博特竞选。

sentences.en: And I just decided we had to.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我们必须这么做。

sentences.en: We had to try.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尝试一下。

sentences.en: You know, I was told by a Texas reporter that in some ways you ran for governor, a position last held by your party in 1995 by another woman, Ann Richards,
sentences.zh: 你知道，一位德州记者告诉我，在某种程度上，你竞选州长——这个职位上一次由你所在政党的人担任是在1995年，由另一位女性安·理查兹担任——

sentences.en: as a sort of sacrificial lamb because it was the longest of long shots.
sentences.zh: 就像是一种替罪羊式的牺牲，因为这是最微乎其微的希望。

sentences.en: You had no real chance.
sentences.zh: 你根本没有真正的胜算。

sentences.en: But basically some Democrat had to do it.
sentences.zh: 但基本上总得有个民主党人站出来。

sentences.en: And so it might as well be you.
sentences.zh: 所以这个人非你莫属。

sentences.en: Did you see it that way, too, when you did it?
sentences.zh: 当你决定参选时，你也是这么看的吗？

sentences.en: No, Lulu, I wouldn't have given up a year of my life away from my family to be on the road all across the state to be a sacrificial lamb.
sentences.zh: 不，露露，我不会为了当替罪羊而放弃一年陪伴家人的时间，在全州到处跑。

sentences.en: No, I'm running to win.
sentences.zh: 不，我参选是为了赢得胜利。

sentences.en: It is a it is not an easy endeavor to do this.
sentences.zh: 做这件事绝非易事。

sentences.en: And it took everything out of me from this last year.
sentences.zh: 过去这一年掏空了我身上的一切。

sentences.en: You know, what strikes me when you say you didn't run as a sacrificial lamb is that the Democratic Party didn't seem to think that you could get as, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你说你不是作为替罪羊参选时，让我感到震惊的是，民主党似乎并不认为你能取得你现在这样的成绩，你知道的，

sentences.en: as close as you've gotten and that you could win.
sentences.zh: 能取得如此接近的进展并赢得胜利。

sentences.en: I mean, your campaign hasn't been supported by national Democratic leadership until recently.
sentences.zh: 我是说，直到最近，你的竞选才得到了全国民主党领导层的支持。

sentences.en: You've been vastly outspent by the Abbott campaign.
sentences.zh: 阿博特阵营的竞选资金远超于你。

sentences.en: But, you know, cut to today.
sentences.zh: 但是，镜头转到今天。

sentences.en: And the polls suggest that you and Abbott are sort of neck and neck.
sentences.zh: 民调显示你和阿博特旗鼓相当。

sentences.en: And I am just sort of wondering, what do you think changed?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，你认为是什么改变了这一切？

sentences.en: Well, we saw from the very beginning that as people got to know who I am, they were with me, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们从一开始就看到，随着人们开始了解我是谁，他们就站在我这边，对吧？

sentences.en: I had low name ID.
sentences.zh: 我的知名度很低。

sentences.en: I'm a House member in Central Texas.
sentences.zh: 我是德州中部的众议员。

sentences.en: So people knew me in Central Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以德州中部的人认识我。

sentences.en: But Texas is like a country.
sentences.zh: 但德州就像一个国家。

sentences.en: It's big and diverse.
sentences.zh: 它广袤而多元。

sentences.en: There's a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多人。

sentences.en: So it's taken a year to reach people.
sentences.zh: 所以花了一年时间才触及到大家。

sentences.en: So whereas my name ID was 20 percent or less when we first launched, it is now 80 percent of Texas voters know who I am.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们刚发起竞选时，我的知名度只有20%或更低，而现在80%的德州选民都知道我是谁了。

sentences.en: We are still reaching those final 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在努力接触最后的这20%。

sentences.en: But the data has shown from the very beginning that people were connecting with my plan for Texas.
sentences.zh: 但数据从一开始就表明，人们与我为德州制定的计划产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: People were connecting with my candidacy.
sentences.zh: 人们与我的候选人身份产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: We just needed to reach them.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要联系到他们即可。

sentences.en: You know, I know you know this, but Texas keeps breaking Democratic hearts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我知道你很清楚这一点，但德州一次又一次地让民主党人心碎。

sentences.en: I mean, it's sort of like this heartbreak that happens over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这有点像那种反复上演的心碎。

sentences.en: And that's because white conservative rural voters, you know, vote at higher rates than urban black, brown and younger voters.
sentences.zh: 这是因为白人保守派农村选民的投票率比城市黑人、棕色人种和年轻选民更高。

sentences.en: There's low turnout in the state, which hurts Democrats often.
sentences.zh: 该州投票率低，这通常对民主党不利。

sentences.en: I mean, what are you doing differently than, say, Beto O'Rourke, who was the last Democrat to run against Abbott?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你做出了什么与众不同的事情，比如贝托·奥罗克，他上一位与阿博特对决的民主党人？

sentences.en: But he had a lot of name recognition, a lot of momentum behind him nationally, and yet he's still lost by 11 points.
sentences.zh: 但他有很高的知名度和全国范围内的强大声势，然而他还是输了11个百分点。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know that I can really compare my candidacy to Beto's.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道自己能否真的将我的竞选与贝托的相提并论。

sentences.en: It's a different time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不同的时代。

sentences.en: I mean, 2026 is a different time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，2026年是一个不同的时代。

sentences.en: Like, the data centers have been a physical manifestation of a governor doing the bidding of the moneyed interest, the biggest moneyed interest in the world, really,
sentences.zh: 比如，数据中心已经成为了一位州长听命于金钱利益、听命于世界上最大金钱利益集团的实体化体现，

sentences.en: and leaving the people of Texas to fend for themselves.
sentences.zh: 却让德州人民自生自灭。

sentences.en: And so, in that way, rural Texas has felt betrayed by Greg Abbott because many of these data centers have descended upon rural Texas where there are no rules, really.
sentences.zh: 因此，在某种程度上，德州农村地区感到被格雷格·阿博特背叛了，因为许多这样的大型数据中心涌入了几乎没有任何规则可言的德州农村。

sentences.en: And the result is that in this state where we struggle from drought, for instance, I was in the panhandle, Amarillo,
sentences.zh: 结果就是，在这个饱受干旱困扰的州里，举个例子，我曾在狭长地带的阿马里洛，

sentences.en: talking to residents where they are fighting the world's largest data center.
sentences.zh: 与当地居民交谈，他们在那里与世界上最大的数据中心进行抗争。

sentences.en: It is called Project Matador.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“斗牛士计划”。

sentences.en: It's investors are Rick Perry, our former governor, and his son.
sentences.zh: 它的投资人是我们的前州长里克·佩里及其儿子。

sentences.en: They negotiated a deal to get all of their water in this drought-prone area for the data center from the city water supply.
sentences.zh: 他们在这个干旱多发地区为该数据中心谈判达成了一项协议，直接从城市供水中获取其所需的所有水资源。

sentences.en: When residents asked, what happens if we run out of water, the response they told me they got from municipal water was, well, we will have to turn off the residents first, right?
sentences.zh: 当居民询问“如果我们水用完了会怎么样”时，他们告诉我从市政供水那里得到的答复是，“好吧，我们得先断掉居民的用水，对吧？”

sentences.en: It's like that's the environment we're living in in Texas.
sentences.zh: 这就像我们在德州所处的环境一样。

sentences.en: And so, people are understanding that we are fighting a fight right now where it's like all of us in the same boat versus like 15 billionaire tech dudes.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们正在意识到，我们现在正在进行一场战斗，这就好比我们所有人都在同一条船上，而对手是大约15个亿万富翁科技大佬。

sentences.en: And the data centers are, again, that physical manifestation of what I call the one fight.
sentences.zh: 数据中心再次成为我所称的那场“唯一的战斗”的实体化体现。

sentences.en: Is Texas going to be a state by and for the people or is this the billionaire's world and we just live here?
sentences.zh: 德州究竟是要成为一个民有、民治、民享的州，还是这只是亿万富翁的世界而我们只是寄居于此？

sentences.en: You know, what I'm hearing you say, and I've heard you talk about this a lot, and it's a common theme among all Democrats at the moment, is that people are angry, which we know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我听到你说的话，我也听你经常谈论这个，这也是目前所有民主党人共同的主题，那就是人们很愤怒，我们都知道这一点，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: People are really mad about the economy, about data centers, about a whole host of issues.
sentences.zh: 人们对经济、对数据中心以及对一系列问题感到非常生气。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering, you know, when you go out to these rural areas, are you trying to get disaffected MAGA voters to turn your way?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，当你去到这些农村地区时，你是否试图争取那些心怀不满的MAGA选民转向支持你？

sentences.en: I mean, what is the overall plan on who to persuade?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于该争取谁的整体计划是什么？

sentences.en: Because obviously your time and your resources are finite, so you have to pick and choose who you're trying to get to come over to listen to your message and to vote for you.
sentences.zh: 因为很明显，你的时间和资源是有限的，所以你必须有所选择，决定试图让谁来倾听你的信息并为你投票。

sentences.en: Who's your coalition?
sentences.zh: 你的联盟由谁组成？

sentences.en: It's everybody.
sentences.zh: 是所有人。

sentences.en: I have not picked and chosen.
sentences.zh: 我没有挑肥拣瘦。

sentences.en: I have been all over the state with all communities, and it is the same message.
sentences.zh: 我带着同样的讯息走遍了全州的各个社群。

sentences.en: It is not moderating a message.
sentences.zh: 这不是在缓和信息。

sentences.en: To be clear, it is not moderating a message.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，这不是在缓和信息。

sentences.en: It is reaching out to Democrats, Republicans, independents with what is a populist message, a message about doing the bidding of the people.
sentences.zh: 这是用一种民粹主义的信息、一种为人民服务的讯息去接触民主党人、共和党人、独立选民。

sentences.en: And so, yes, I need Trump supporters to support this race.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我需要特朗普的支持者来支持这场竞选。

sentences.en: Trump won Texas.
sentences.zh: 特朗普赢了德州。

sentences.en: Trump won the Latino vote in Texas.
sentences.zh: 特朗普赢得了德州的拉丁裔选票。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: They are invited to be part of this coalition.
sentences.zh: 他们被邀请成为这个联盟的一部分。

sentences.en: And in this time when people are disappointed in both political parties, both Democrats and Republicans, it creates a space and an opportunity for Texans to vote for the candidate.
sentences.zh: 在这个人们对民主、共和两党都感到失望的时期，这为德州人投票支持候选人创造了空间和机遇。

sentences.en: What's been the thing that's most surprised you when you're out among maybe communities that you wouldn't naturally see as supporting you?
sentences.zh: 在深入那些你本不觉得会支持你的社群时，最让你惊讶的事情是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, you know, you represented obviously Austin, which is one of the most liberal places in the state.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你显然代表过奥斯汀，那是该州最自由主义的地方之一。

sentences.en: Again, talking about the one fight, when I was in Red Oak, Texas, this is a suburb outside of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 再次谈到那场唯一的战斗，当时我在德克萨斯州的雷德奥克，这是达拉斯郊外的一个卫星城。

sentences.en: Actually, it is a rural neighborhood community where they have big acreage lots and a school down the street.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它是一个农村邻里社区，那里有很大面积的宅基地，街头尽头就有一所学校。

sentences.en: They invited me in because they have seven data centers moving into their community, right?
sentences.zh: 他们邀请我进去，因为有七个数据中心正要搬进他们的社区，对吧？

sentences.en: And this one that's 900 acres large right next door to the home that I was invited into.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个占地900英亩的大型数据中心，就紧挨着邀请我进去的那座房子。

sentences.en: And I was sitting in a living room with MAGA.
sentences.zh: 我当时正坐在一间MAGA支持者的起居室里。

sentences.en: And they knew Greg Abbott had sold them out.
sentences.zh: 他们知道格雷格·阿博特出卖了他们。

sentences.en: But they weren't sure about me and they had questions.
sentences.zh: 但他们对我不确定，他们有问题要问。

sentences.en: So I sat down.
sentences.zh: 所以我坐了下来。

sentences.en: I said, okay, let's go.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，来吧。

sentences.en: Ask me.
sentences.zh: 尽管问我。

sentences.en: And they wanted to ask me like culture war questions, right?
sentences.zh: 他们想问我一些文化战争的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: They wanted to ask me about constitutional carry.
sentences.zh: 他们想问我关于宪法载枪权的问题。

sentences.en: I said, what do you call constitutional carry?
sentences.zh: 我说，你们所说的宪法载枪权是指什么？

sentences.en: I call permitless carry, and I voted against it because I believe we should have background checks to have a gun.
sentences.zh: 我将之称为无证持枪，我投了反对票，因为我认为要拥有枪支就必须进行背景调查。

sentences.en: They asked me about Sharia law.
sentences.zh: 他们问我关于沙里亚伊斯兰法的问题。

sentences.en: And I said, well, I don't really know what Sharia law is.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，其实我不太了解什么是沙里亚法。

sentences.en: But what I worry about is that regular Muslim Texans are going to be discriminated against because people think they are practicing this thing called Sharia law that probably most of them don't even know what it is,
sentences.zh: 但我担心的是，普通的德克萨斯州穆斯林将会受到歧视，因为人们会认为他们在践行这种叫做沙里亚法的东西，而可能他们大多数人甚至都不知道那是什么，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And so we engaged, which I think is a rare thing for people of different political parties and for leaders, elected Democratic leaders, to sit down with MAGA and say, let's talk.
sentences.zh: 所以我们进行了接触，我认为这对于不同政见的群体以及领导人、当选的民主党领导人来说是一件罕见的事，他们能和MAGA坐在一起说，我们来谈谈。

sentences.en: And to agree to disagree where we disagree, to find common ground where we do,
sentences.zh: 在有分歧的地方求同存异，在有共识的地方寻找共同点，

sentences.en: but then ultimately to recognize while we have been fighting these culture wars for 10 years in this country,
sentences.zh: 但最终认识到，尽管我们在过去十年里一直在国内进行这些文化战争，

sentences.en: culture wars that are not winnable because they depend on your personal experiences,
sentences.zh: 这些赢不了的文化战争，因为它们取决于你的个人经历，

sentences.en: your lived experience, that the only winners of these culture wars have been tech giants that are amassing our money and our power and all our data.
sentences.zh: 你的人生经历，而这些文化战争唯一的赢家是那些大肆搜刮我们的金钱、权力和所有数据的科技巨头。

sentences.en: And if you believe recent reports are about to blow up the world, if we don't come together fast to save ourselves.
sentences.zh: 如果你相信最近的报道，如果我们不迅速团结起来拯救自己，世界就要炸了。

sentences.en: How persuasive do you think you've been?
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己有多大的说服力？

sentences.en: I think people are tired of fighting culture war fights.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们已经厌倦了文化战争的争斗。

sentences.en: I think there is an opportunity if we choose to lead and we choose to take it to forge a new way forward that is almost postpartisan in recognition of disappointment again in both parties because both parties,
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果我们选择领导并抓住机会，就有可能开辟一条几乎超越党派的新前进道路，这再次反映出人们对两党感到的失望，因为两党，

sentences.en: frankly, are corrupted by corporate influence.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，都已经被企业利益腐蚀了。

sentences.en: I mean, I have seen so many, even Democrats, grants stand on culture war issues only to fight, only to vote with corporate interests.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我见过太多人，甚至是民主党人，在文化战争的议题上立场坚定，转头却去为企业利益投票。

sentences.en: And none of us are better for it, right?
sentences.zh: 这对我们谁都没有好处，对吧？

sentences.en: I am not here to win moral victories.
sentences.zh: 我来这里不是为了赢得道义上的胜利。

sentences.en: I am here to win results for the people of Texas.
sentences.zh: 我是来为德克萨斯州人民争取实效的。

sentences.en: I want to learn a little bit more about you and your background.
sentences.zh: 我想多了解一下你和你的背景。

sentences.en: You're a Texas state representative, as you've mentioned.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，你是德克萨斯州众议员。

sentences.en: You're a labor lawyer, a former school board president.
sentences.zh: 你是一名劳工律师，曾任学区董事会主席。

sentences.en: Your father was a Democratic Party chair in the state for 13 years and was a former judge.
sentences.zh: 你的父亲曾担任该州民主党主席长达13年，并曾是一名法官。

sentences.en: Your mom was born in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 你的母亲出生在墨西哥。

sentences.en: What was your family like growing up?
sentences.zh: 你成长中的家庭是怎样的？

sentences.en: My parents started off as legal aid lawyers.
sentences.zh: 我的父母最初是法律援助律师。

sentences.en: They represented farm workers.
sentences.zh: 他们代表农场工人。

sentences.en: And I was born to high school sweethearts.
sentences.zh: 我是高中青梅竹马的父母所生。

sentences.en: They were very young when they had me.
sentences.zh: 他们生我的时候很年轻。

sentences.en: So in some ways, I grew up with them.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，我和他们一起长大。

sentences.en: I grew up in Brownsville on the border with Mexico, Matamoros, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我在布朗斯维尔长大，那里与墨西哥的马塔莫罗斯接壤。

sentences.en: And back then, we used to cross back and forth all the time.
sentences.zh: 在过去，我们经常来回过境。

sentences.en: I mean, we'd go for breakfast on the weekends to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，周末我们会去墨西哥吃早餐。

sentences.en: We would go shopping for things in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我们会去墨西哥买东西。

sentences.en: We were a binational community.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个双国社区。

sentences.en: How did that make you see the United States?
sentences.zh: 这让你如何看待美国？

sentences.en: Like, I've been there many times to that part of the country and to Brownsville in particular.
sentences.zh: 比如，我去过那个国家很多次，特别是布朗斯维尔。

sentences.en: It's a very unique and specific place.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常独特和特殊的地方。

sentences.en: And I just wonder how it made you view America or what you sort of learned about America growing up there.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道这让你如何看待美国，或者你在那里长大时对美国有了什么了解。

sentences.en: I think there's a kind of very strong patriotism that comes from growing up on the border.
sentences.zh: 我认为在边境长大带来了一种非常强烈的爱国主义。

sentences.en: I tell this story.
sentences.zh: 我讲过这个故事。

sentences.en: I specifically remember being a little girl and crossing the border with my dad.
sentences.zh: 我特别记得自己还是个小女孩时，和爸爸一起过境。

sentences.en: I think we went to go eat breakfast in Mexico and being struck by the extreme poverty, by people begging on the streets.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是去墨西哥吃早餐，被极端的贫困和街头乞讨的人们深深震撼了。

sentences.en: And it really hurt to see through the eyes of a child.
sentences.zh: 用孩子的眼睛看到这些真的很痛心。

sentences.en: And I asked my dad, how come in Mexico there are people begging on the streets and not in the United States?
sentences.zh: 我问爸爸，为什么墨西哥街头有人乞讨而美国没有？

sentences.en: Because we didn't have any of that then.
sentences.zh: 因为那时候我们没有这些。

sentences.en: And he said, and I'll never forget, he said, because in Mexico, they have the rich and the poor and not much in between.
sentences.zh: 他说，我永远不会忘记，他说，因为在墨西哥，有富人也有穷人，中间阶层很少。

sentences.en: And in America, we have a strong middle class.
sentences.zh: 而在美国，我们拥有强大的中产阶级。

sentences.en: And he said it with a pride, right?
sentences.zh: 他说这话时带着自豪，对吧？

sentences.en: My dad, who also grew up on the border, said it with this patriotism, this proud patriotism.
sentences.zh: 我父亲也在边境长大，他说这话时带着这种爱国主义，这种自豪的爱国主义。

sentences.en: And he was talking about the American dream.
sentences.zh: 他在谈论美国梦。

sentences.en: And it has occurred to me that that sense of who we are, who our identity is as Americans and even as Texans to some extent, is being loSt.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到，我们是谁、作为美国人的身份认同甚至在某种程度上作为德克萨斯人的身份认同，这种感觉正在丧失。

sentences.en: And that so many working Texans, and especially young people, don't believe in the American dream.
sentences.zh: 许多辛勤工作的德克萨斯人，尤其是年轻人，不再相信美国梦了。

sentences.en: They don't think it's real.
sentences.zh: 他们认为那不是真的。

sentences.en: They don't think that hard work pays.
sentences.zh: 他们认为努力工作没有回报。

sentences.en: And we have to get back to a time when hard work pays, when the American dream is alive.
sentences.zh: 我们必须回到那个努力工作有回报、美国梦依然存在的时代。

sentences.en: That is who we are.
sentences.zh: 这才是我们。

sentences.en: That is our strength as a country, as a people.
sentences.zh: 这是我们作为国家、作为人民的力量所在。

sentences.en: Because you know the area really well, I am curious what you think has been happening down in the Rio Grande Valley.
sentences.zh: 因为你对这个地区非常了解，我很想知道你认为格兰德河谷最近发生了什么。

sentences.en: You know, we've seen it swing from firmly Democratic to Republican.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们看到它从坚定的民主党阵营摇摆为共和党阵营。

sentences.en: In 2016, it was a 60-point-plus Democratic area.
sentences.zh: 在2016年，这是一个民主党领先60多点的地区。

sentences.en: And then it has been turning and turning.
sentences.zh: 然后它一直在转变。

sentences.en: And then in 2024, Trump won it solidly.
sentences.zh: 接着在2024年，特朗普稳稳地赢了那里。

sentences.en: And I just wonder what you think Republicans figured out to catch fire there.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你认为共和党人找到了什么诀窍才在那里大获成功。

sentences.en: I think there were a couple of things that were happening.
sentences.zh: 我认为当时发生了几件事。

sentences.en: I think, one, Latinos along the border were angry about border security, right?
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为边境地区的拉丁裔对边境安全感到愤怒，对吧？

sentences.en: Because this was, remember, at a time when we had the caravans crossing, we had people sleeping under bridges.
sentences.zh: 因为大家还记得，当时有移民大篷车过境，有人睡在桥底下。

sentences.en: It felt chaotic.
sentences.zh: 这感觉很混乱。

sentences.en: It did not inspire confidence.
sentences.zh: 这并没有激起人们的信心。

sentences.en: And border communities were angry about that.
sentences.zh: 边境社区对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Those are mostly Latino communities.
sentences.zh: 这些大多是拉丁裔社区。

sentences.en: I also think that Latinos vote their pocketbooks.
sentences.zh: 我也认为拉丁裔投票是为了他们的钱袋子。

sentences.en: And Trump was promising to deliver a kind of economic prosperity that was appealing.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普承诺带来的那种经济繁荣很有吸引力。

sentences.en: But fast forward to today, and yes, we all want border security, but these ICE raids are making us less secure, not more secure, right?
sentences.zh: 但快进到今天，是的，我们都想要边境安全，但这些移民及海关执法局（ICE）的突袭行动让我们更不安全，而不是更安全，对吧？

sentences.en: And people are really angry about the racial profiling that's happened.
sentences.zh: 人们对发生的种族Profiling（种族定性）感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And we've had even Americans, American boys on their way to enlist in the Marines, pulled from their car by ICE and beaten, right?
sentences.zh: 甚至连美国人、正准备加入海军陆战队的美国男孩，都被ICE从车里拖出来殴打，对吧？

sentences.en: We had a man who was killed in Houston a few months ago on his way to work, a case of mistaken identity, where they shot first, asked questions later.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，休斯敦有一个人在上班路上被杀，这是一起身份认错的案件，他们先开枪再问话。

sentences.en: I could go on.
sentences.zh: 我可以继续说下去。

sentences.en: That is the reality we are dealing with in Texas, and Latinos are angry and scared.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在德克萨斯州面对的现实，拉丁裔感到愤怒和害怕。

sentences.en: And there is a motivation, really, to vote for change in this election that I have not seen before.
sentences.zh: 在这次选举中，真正存在一种前所未见的投票支持变革的动力。

sentences.en: And not to mention the high-cost crisis that we are in in Texas, where the price of gas, the price of electricity, through the roof, property taxes, through the roof,
sentences.zh: 更不用说我们在德克萨斯州面临的高成本危机了，油价、电价飙升，房产税飙升，

sentences.en: the cost of groceries.
sentences.zh: 杂货的价格也是如此。

sentences.en: And they know who's been in charge.
sentences.zh: 他们知道是谁在掌权。

sentences.en: They know who to blame.
sentences.zh: 他们知道该怪谁。

sentences.en: I'd like to stay with immigration for a moment because—and understand a little bit of how you see it and what your platform is should you become governor.
sentences.zh: 我想暂时留在移民话题上——因为——并且想稍微了解一下你是如何看待它的，以及如果你当选州长，你的施政纲领是什么。

sentences.en: Because, as you know, many people see Democrats as weak on the border.
sentences.zh: 因为如你所知，许多人认为民主党在边境问题上软弱。

sentences.en: And Abbott has used his authority to send the National Guard down to the border, among other things, Operation Lone Star.
sentences.zh: 阿博特利用他的权力派遣国民警卫队前往边境，其中包括“孤星行动”。

sentences.en: And I wonder what approaches of Trump or Abbott do you agree with?
sentences.zh: 我想知道你赞同特朗普或阿博特的哪些做法？

sentences.en: I mean, we have seen the border become a much more secure place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们看到边境变得安全得多了。

sentences.en: You know, illegal crossings have plummeted under the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在特朗普政府领导下，非法越境人数骤降。

sentences.en: I think we cannot be treating people who have been in our communities for 20 years, hardworking, law-abiding members of our community,
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们不能把那些在我们社区生活了20年、辛勤工作、遵纪守法的社区成员，

sentences.en: like we are treating somebody who needs to be vetted coming across the border.
sentences.zh: 当成那些需要经过背景审查才能过境的人来对待。

sentences.en: Those are two different kinds of people who need to be treated differently.
sentences.zh: 这是两种不同类型的人，需要区别对待。

sentences.en: We should have a path to legalization for people who are here.
sentences.zh: 我们应该为已经在这里的人提供一条合法化路径。

sentences.en: We should also have order at the border and security at the border.
sentences.zh: 我们也应该在边境保持秩序和安全。

sentences.en: But again, just to understand sort of specifically, what exactly would you do differently than Governor Abbott has done in terms of border security?
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，为了具体了解一下，在边境安全方面，你究竟会采取与阿博特州长不同的什么做法？

sentences.en: Would you repeal SB4, which is the Abbott law that makes unauthorized entry into Texas a criminal offense?
sentences.zh: 你会废除SB4吗？这是阿博特签署的将非法进入德克萨斯州定为刑事犯罪的法律。

sentences.en: Well, I wouldn't have the power to repeal that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有权力废除它。

sentences.en: But would you try and propose it?
sentences.zh: 但你会尝试去提出它吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: Would propose—I mean, do you think it should be repealed?
sentences.zh: 会提出——我的意思是，你认为应该废除它吗？

sentences.en: I don't support—and I voted against it, and I stand by my record.
sentences.zh: 我不支持——我投了反对票，我坚守我的记录。

sentences.en: But I'm not going to pretend like I'll have the power to convince the legislature to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我不会假装我有权力说服立法机关这样做。

sentences.en: We still—even if I win, we still have Republican control of everything in this state.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然——即使我赢了，这个州的一切仍然由共和党控制。

sentences.en: And again, my agenda will be one that 99 percent of us agree on, which is to secure the American dream, to save Texas public schools, put money in your pocket, a populist agenda,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我的议程将是获得我们99%的人赞同的议程，也就是捍卫美国梦、拯救德克萨斯州公立学校、让你的钱包鼓起来，这是一个民粹主义议程，

sentences.en: rather than fight fights that I know I can't win.
sentences.zh: 而不是去打那些我知道赢不了的仗。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: So what you're telling me is that you might not agree with SB4, which also authorizes the state to remove those here illegally.
sentences.zh: 所以你告诉我的是，你可能不同意SB4，该法案还授权州政府驱逐非法滞留者。

sentences.en: That's typically a federal function.
sentences.zh: 这通常是联邦的职能。

sentences.en: But you're not going to try and change it because you feel like you can't do it.
sentences.zh: 但你不会试图去改变它，因为你觉得自己做不到。

sentences.en: So then what's in it for Democrats who want to see substantial changes to the law in Texas to put you in office if you won't be able to deliver on sort of key issues for them?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于那些希望看到德克萨斯州法律发生实质性改变、并希望你当选以兑现他们关键诉求的民主党人来说，选你有什么好处呢？

sentences.en: Well, Lulu, there are so many things in Texas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，露露，德克萨斯州有太多问题了。

sentences.en: This is not a blue state.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个蓝州。

sentences.en: This is Texas, where we have Greg Abbott putting Texas National Guard in detention centers so that these private prison companies can maximize their profits.
sentences.zh: 这是德克萨斯州，格雷格·阿博特把德克萨斯州国民警卫队关进拘留中心，好让这些私营监狱公司赚取最高利润。

sentences.en: We have kids being locked up with their parents because Greg Abbott allows for the licensing of these detention centers for little kids to be locked up with their parents.
sentences.zh: 我们有孩子和父母一起被关起来，因为格雷格·阿博特允许向这些拘留中心颁发执照，好让小孩子们和父母一起被关起来。

sentences.en: We have a governor who turns the other way when Texans are being mowed down on our streets.
sentences.zh: 当德克萨斯人在我们的街头被残害时，我们的州长却视而不见。

sentences.en: Like, there is a lot besides the repeal of SB4.
sentences.zh: 所以，除了废除SB4之外，还有很多事要做。

sentences.en: And having a governor who has the courage to stand up for Texans will be night and day in this state.
sentences.zh: 拥有一个有勇气为德克萨斯人挺身而出的州长，将使这个州发生天翻地覆的变化。

sentences.en: I mean, how would you like to see ICE operate in Texas then?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那么你希望看到ICE在德克萨斯州如何运作？

sentences.en: I'm just trying to understand if you become governor, how you would address some of the things that you see are wrong.
sentences.zh: 我只是想了解，如果你当选州长，你将如何解决你认为不对的那些事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I would use, again, I would use everything from the bully pulpit to the courts to defend the rights of Texans.
sentences.zh: 我会使用——再次强调，我会利用从道德制高点到法庭的一切手段来捍卫德克萨斯人的权利。

sentences.en: We have laws here in Texas where we can't have masked agents.

sentences.en: We don't have lawlessness that is resulting in people being run over and killed by federal agents.
sentences.zh: 我们不能无法无天到导致联邦特工撞死和枪杀平民的地步。

sentences.en: Like, we have transparency, accountability, basic protections for Texans that aren't being respected.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们有透明度、问责制、对德克萨斯人的基本保护，而这些目前都没有受到尊重。

sentences.en: Do you think ICE needs to be disbanded?
sentences.zh: 你认为ICE需要被解散吗？

sentences.en: I think what is happening needs to stop.

sentences.en: ICE should not be doing this.

sentences.en: People fear them.

sentences.en: People are angry at them.
sentences.zh: 人们对他们感到愤怒。

sentences.en: It is chaotic.

sentences.en: They should not be here.
sentences.zh: 他们不应该在这里。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things, staying with the border, that you've also spoken out about is Elon Musk in particular.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于边境问题，你公开直言的另一个对象特别是埃隆·马斯克。

sentences.en: You know, SpaceX is based in the Valley.
sentences.zh: 你知道，SpaceX的总部设在河谷。

sentences.en: It even has a town called Starbase there.
sentences.zh: 它甚至在那里有一个叫星际基地的城镇。

sentences.en: It employs thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 它雇用了数千名员工。

sentences.en: Musk has even pledged $20 million to a local school district down there.
sentences.zh: 马斯克甚至承诺向当地的一个学区捐赠2000万美元。

sentences.en: And you've been very critical of him and the way he's operated his businesses in Texas.
sentences.zh: 而你一直非常批评他以及他在德克萨斯州经营企业的方式。

sentences.en: And I'd love for you to explain why.
sentences.zh: 我很想请你解释一下原因。

sentences.en: I'm actually more critical of the way Abbott lets him abuse our resources, right?
sentences.zh: 其实我更批评阿博特让他滥用我们资源的这种方式，对吧？

sentences.en: I blame him less than I blame our weak leader who doesn't defend Texans.
sentences.zh: 比起他，我更责怪我们那个不保护德克萨斯人的软弱领导人。

sentences.en: So here's the record.
sentences.zh: 这就是记录。

sentences.en: The record is that Elon Musk has given Greg Abbott half a million dollars to his campaign.
sentences.zh: 记录显示，埃隆·马斯克已向格雷格·阿博特的竞选活动捐赠了五十万美元。

sentences.en: And he has received $1.6 billion in property tax breaks for his company, TerraFab.
sentences.zh: 而他的公司 TerraFab 则获得了 16 亿美元的房产税减免。

sentences.en: He's received tens of millions of dollars just in cash from the state of Texas for Starbase.
sentences.zh: 仅就“星际基地”项目，他从得克萨斯州获得了数千万美元的现金资助。

sentences.en: He has received the governor's intervention in contracting for broadband so that he could receive a $100 million broadband contract.
sentences.zh: 在宽带合同的签订上，他得到了州长的干预，从而获得了一笔 1 亿美元的宽带合同。

sentences.en: This is the reality we are living in.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们生活的现实。

sentences.en: Elon Musk has also been an enormous contributor to the Republican Party, not only Greg Abbott, but the Republican Party writ large.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克也是共和党的大额捐赠者，不仅支持格雷格·阿博特，而且对整个共和党都倾注了巨资。

sentences.en: You know, tens of millions of dollars being poured into the race in Texas in particular, but, you know, all over the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特别是得克萨斯州的选战，还有全国各地，都有数千万美元倾注其中。

sentences.en: I mean, how do you see his role in the politics of your state?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你如何看待他在你们州政治中所扮演的角色？

sentences.en: Yes, he has an outsized influence, to say the least, in our politics.
sentences.zh: 是的，他在我们政治中的影响力可以说是极其巨大的。

sentences.en: You should not be able to spend that much money.
sentences.zh: 一个人不应该能够花那么多钱。

sentences.en: That's gross that he has that kind of influence over our political system.
sentences.zh: 他在我们的政治体制中拥有这种影响力，这太令人反感了。

sentences.en: I just think that there must be some tension there because he is a big employer in the state.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，由于他是本州的大雇主，其中必然会存在一些紧张关系。

sentences.en: He moved a lot of his businesses to the state of Texas.
sentences.zh: 他把许多业务都搬到了得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: You want people to have good paying jobs.
sentences.zh: 人们都希望拥有薪酬优厚的工作。

sentences.en: You want people to be employed.
sentences.zh: 人们都希望能够就业。

sentences.en: And obviously, you know, he's got a very successful series of companies.
sentences.zh: 显然，你知道，他拥有一系列非常成功的公司。

sentences.en: So how do you imagine that you would manage that relationship with someone who clearly supports a different agenda?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为你将如何与一个明显支持不同政治议程的人处理好这种关系呢？

sentences.en: Well, listen, I launched this campaign with this saying my grandmother used to tell me growing up,
sentences.zh: 嗯，听着，我发起这场竞选时，引用了我祖母从小常对我说的一句话：

sentences.en: no te dejes, there's not a direct translation for this saying, but it basically means know your worth and fight to defend it.
sentences.zh: no te dejes，这句话没有直接的翻译，但它基本上意味着认清你的价值并为捍卫它而战。

sentences.en: I mean, Elon Musk is lucky he is here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，埃隆·马斯克能来到这里算是很幸运了。

sentences.en: Yes, there are good jobs that he is providing, but also he's getting tremendous taxpayer dollars that is not justified, really.
sentences.zh: 是的，他提供了不错的工作岗位，但与此同时，他也获得了巨额纳税人资金，这其实是不合理的。

sentences.en: Do you think he should get out of the state?
sentences.zh: 你认为他应该离开这个州吗？

sentences.en: People see it.
sentences.zh: 大家都看在眼里。

sentences.en: He doesn't need to get out of the state.
sentences.zh: 他不需要离开这个州。

sentences.en: He just needs to abide by the rules like everybody else says.
sentences.zh: 他只需要像其他人一样遵守规则就行了。

sentences.en: We all pay our taxes.
sentences.zh: 我们都在纳税。

sentences.en: Why shouldn't Elon Musk pay his taxes in Texas, too?
sentences.zh: 为什么埃隆·马斯克不也应该在得克萨斯州纳税呢？

sentences.en: You know, Gina, you're sort of describing the way that many Texans feel disempowered and the way that the economy has functioned, in your view, against ordinary Texans.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，你刚才的描述，正体现了许多得克萨斯人所感到的无力感，在你看来，这种经济运作方式对普通得克萨斯人是不利的。

sentences.en: But I do think Republicans would argue that their policies have made Texas one of the most business-friendly states in the entire country.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，共和党人会辩称，他们的政策使得克萨斯州成为全美最适合经商的州之一。

sentences.en: It has the second largest economy after California.
sentences.zh: 这里拥有仅次于加利福尼亚州的第二大经济体。

sentences.en: Isn't that good stewardship of the state?
sentences.zh: 难道这不是对该州很好的治理吗？

sentences.en: Well, Lulu, there's no question that corporations love Greg Abbott and Texas, but the reality is we have the most people without health insurance of any state,
sentences.zh: 嗯，露露，毫无疑问，大企业喜欢格雷格·阿博特和得克萨斯州，但现实是，在全美各州中，我们拥有最多没有健康保险的人口，

sentences.en: despite the fact that Texans work more hours than the national average.
sentences.zh: 尽管得克萨斯人比全国平均水平工作时间更长。

sentences.en: We have the most children without health insurance of any state in America.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有全美各州中最多没有健康保险的儿童。

sentences.en: We have the most people disconnected from their electricity because they cannot afford to pay their bills of any state in America.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有全美各州中最多因支付不起账单而被断电的人。

sentences.en: We have the most bankruptcies of any state in America, and it is small businesses that are struggling to keep their doors open.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有全美各州中最多的破产案例，而且正是小企业在艰难维系。

sentences.en: We have over 150 whole school districts operating at four days a week because they can't afford to operate at five days a week.
sentences.zh: 我们有 150 多个整个学区被迫实行每周四天上课，因为他们无力承担五天上课的费用。

sentences.en: That is Greg Abbott's record.
sentences.zh: 这就是格雷格·阿博特的政绩。

sentences.en: So, yes, there's a lot of money that flows through Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有大量的资金在得克萨斯州流动。

sentences.en: There is a lot of money that is made in Texas by the people of Texas, but the people are not sharing in that economic wealth.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯人确实在得克萨斯州创造了大量财富，但普通民众并没有分享到这种经济红利。

sentences.en: In fact, Texans are struggling more than they were 12 years ago.
sentences.zh: 事实上，得克萨斯人的生活比 12 年前更加艰难。

sentences.en: Thirty-three presidents.
sentences.zh: 三十三位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 430 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨 4 点 30 分给总统打电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想要探索下一颗恒星之外的奥秘。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: Sixty super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 六十款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎每年都是联盟中最好的球队。

sentences.en: Fifty-three thousand five hundred puzzles.
sentences.zh: 五万三千五百个拼图。

sentences.en: I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: Twenty-five thousand recipes.
sentences.zh: 两万五千个食谱。

sentences.en: And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢单锅食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝 175 周年，伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受 nytimes.com slash subscribe 上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to pivot a little bit to something that you've talked about, which is seeing yourself as a populist and not a liberal or a progressive.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要把话题转向你曾谈到过的一个方面，那就是你认为自己是民粹主义者，而不是自由派或进步派。

sentences.en: Your voting record in the statehouse is, by all accounts, pretty liberal.
sentences.zh: 从各方面来看，你在州议会的投票记录都相当自由派。

sentences.en: You were, in 2019, ranked the most liberal member of the Texas House.
sentences.zh: 在 2019 年，你被评为得克萨斯州众议院中最具自由派倾向的议员。

sentences.en: And it was a title that you sort of openly embraced.
sentences.zh: 你当时也算是公开接受了这一头衔。

sentences.en: And I'm just curious how you define the difference between populist and progressive.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你如何界定民粹主义者和进步派之间的区别？

sentences.en: And tell me why you've landed on populist as a label for yourself now.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我，为什么你现在选择用“民粹主义者”这个标签来定义自己？

sentences.en: I think populist meets the moment of our time.
sentences.zh: 我认为民粹主义契合我们时代的需要。

sentences.en: Again, the one fight.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是一场斗争。

sentences.en: The one fight in this country.
sentences.zh: 这是这个国家的一场斗争。

sentences.en: And it is about economic power.
sentences.zh: 它关乎经济权力。

sentences.en: And populism is about economic power.
sentences.zh: 而民粹主义正是关乎经济权力。

sentences.en: And whereas I do think in the past we evaluated politics as right versus left, I just don't think those labels apply at this moment in history.
sentences.zh: 虽然我认为过去我们是用右翼对左翼来评估政治，但我认为这些标签在历史的这个时刻已经不再适用。

sentences.en: Not in this moment in political history.
sentences.zh: 在这个政治历史时刻不适用了。

sentences.en: We see that things are so stacked against working people in this country.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，这个国家的情况对劳动人民极不公平。

sentences.en: And so, listen, it's just a label.
sentences.zh: 所以，听着，这只是一个标签。

sentences.en: But if I were to pick a label to describe what are my politics, it is economic populism.
sentences.zh: 但如果我要选一个标签来描述我的政治立场，那就是经济民粹主义。

sentences.en: It happens to be a type of politics that is rooted in our Texas history.
sentences.zh: 这恰好是一种植根于我们得州历史的政治流派。

sentences.en: It was LBJ's grandfather, who was part of the Farmers Alliance, that organized farmers against big railroads that were taking advantage of them.
sentences.zh: 正是林登·约翰逊的祖父，作为农民联盟的成员，组织农民对抗那些盘剥他们的铁路大亨。

sentences.en: And in much the same way, we have working Texans who are up against, again, tech giants, big tech.
sentences.zh: 同理，我们如今的得州劳动人民，面对的正是科技巨头，也就是大科技公司。

sentences.en: And so, I chose this title to define what is my politics because I do think that this has to be the politics of the moment to meet the challenges of the moment.
sentences.zh: 因此，我选择这个头衔来定义我的政治立场，因为我坚信，这必须是应对当前挑战的时代政治。

sentences.en: Is part of it also that this sort of progressive liberal label could be perceived as pretty toxic by certain members of the state that you're trying to get to vote for you?
sentences.zh: 这其中是否也有这样一个原因：在那些你试图争取选票的本州选民中，进步派或自由派这种标签可能会被视为带有很强的负面色彩？

sentences.en: No, it is not that because I but what I think it is, is that those labels have been associated with culture wars.
sentences.zh: 不，并不是这样，因为我认为，这些标签一直与文化战争联系在一起。

sentences.en: And and I just don't think that the culture wars are the fight of 2026.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，文化战争并不是 2026 年的斗争焦点。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to sit with it.
sentences.zh: 我只是在细细体会。

sentences.en: I'm not trying to be difficult.
sentences.zh: 我不是在抬杠。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to understand a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我只是想稍微理解一下。

sentences.en: So you're a populist progressive.
sentences.zh: 所以你是一个民粹主义的进步派。

sentences.en: It's not an either or thing.
sentences.zh: 这不是非此即彼的事情。

sentences.en: Well, look, I just think that progressive politics is associated with culture wars.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，我只是觉得进步派政治与文化战争联系在一起。

sentences.en: And I have no interest in.
sentences.zh: 而我毫无兴趣去……

sentences.en: In fighting culture wars at this time,
sentences.zh: 在这个时候卷入文化战争，

sentences.en: fighting culture wars at this time is not a winnable fight is the fight that divides us because it is the fight about who we are in our lived experiences.
sentences.zh: 在这个时候进行文化战争是一场赢不了的斗争，这是一场分裂我们的斗争，因为它关乎我们在现实生活经验中的身份认同。

sentences.en: And that is not the fight of 2026.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是 2026 年的斗争。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know that that's true.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道这是否属实。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it is culture wars, but it's also being a progressive could be about the way you use taxation to redistribute wealth.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这确实关乎文化战争，但作为一个进步派，也可能关乎你如何利用税收来重新分配财富。

sentences.en: It could mean the way you want to have the health care system work in terms of, you know, supporting Obamacare, Medicare for all.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着你希望医疗体制如何运作，比如支持奥巴马医改、全民医保等。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not just a label that has to do with culture wars.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这不仅仅是一个与文化战争有关的标签。

sentences.en: It means more than that.
sentences.zh: 它的含义远不止于此。

sentences.en: Well, and it may mean more than that to you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对你来说它可能意味着更多。

sentences.en: But I think to a lot of people, it means the culture war fights because those are the fights we've been fighting for the last 10 years.
sentences.zh: 但在许多人看来，它就意味着文化战争的冲突，因为那是我们过去 10 年一直在打的仗。

sentences.en: So it comes back to my thing that it's toxic.
sentences.zh: 所以这又回到了我的观点，即它是有毒的。

sentences.en: No, it's not it's not that it comes back to it doesn't meet the political moment of our time.
sentences.zh: 不，并不是说它有毒，而是说它不符合我们时代的政治需要。

sentences.en: It is not what 2026 is about.
sentences.zh: 这并不是 2026 年的核心议题。

sentences.en: Look, we are facing almost existential crisis in this country because tech giants are having their way with us.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们这个国家正面临着近乎生存危机的局面，因为科技巨头正在为所欲为。

sentences.en: Like there is one fight and we are so caught up in fighting each other in a divided nation,
sentences.zh: 这就好比这是一场斗争，而我们在一个分裂的国家里却深陷内讧，

sentences.en: fighting each other over the ways we disagree about social issues and culture wars that we're all about to lose.
sentences.zh: 为了我们在社会议题和文化战争上的分歧而互相争斗，以至于我们所有人都要输掉一切。

sentences.en: And so I'm not going to perpetuate that anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不会再延续这种争斗了。

sentences.en: You clearly, though, do understand that some of this these issues do motivate people.
sentences.zh: 不过，你显然也明白，其中某些议题确实能够激起人们的情绪。

sentences.en: And, you know, you released a very personal ad early in your campaign talking about the issue of abortion in Texas.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你在竞选初期发布了一则非常个人化的广告，谈到了得克萨斯州的堕胎问题。

sentences.en: Abortion is almost completely banned from conception with no exception for rape or inceSt.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州几乎完全禁止从受孕开始的堕胎，且对强奸或乱伦没有例外规定。

sentences.en: And you really discussed something that was very personal to you.
sentences.zh: 你确实讨论了一件对你而言非常私人的事情。

sentences.en: Can you tell me that story and why you wanted to talk about it?
sentences.zh: 你能讲讲那个故事以及你为什么要谈论它吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: So my first pregnancy shortly after I was married was diagnosed with I was diagnosed with a fetus that had trisomy 18,
sentences.zh: 我结婚不久后的第一次怀孕，被诊断出胎儿患有 18 三体综合征，

sentences.en: which was described to me by doctors as not compatible with life.
sentences.zh: 医生向我描述说这与生命是不兼容的。

sentences.en: And I had to make a decision about whether or not to terminate that pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 我必须决定是否终止这次妊娠。

sentences.en: I had a week's time to decide that.
sentences.zh: 我有一周的时间来做出决定。

sentences.en: I consulted with my priest and the nun at my church.
sentences.zh: 我咨询了我的神父和教堂的修女。

sentences.en: I prayed with my husband.
sentences.zh: 我和丈夫一起祈祷。

sentences.en: We both took that time to figure out what to do.
sentences.zh: 我们都利用这段时间来弄清楚该怎么做。

sentences.en: My family was so supportive.
sentences.zh: 我的家人给予了极大的支持。

sentences.en: I had a small Christian community that held my hand along the way.
sentences.zh: 我有一个小型基督教社群，一路握着我的手给予我支持。

sentences.en: And I ultimately decided not to terminate that pregnancy and carry it forward to term.
sentences.zh: 我最终决定不终止妊娠，而是将其足月生下。

sentences.en: She didn't make it.
sentences.zh: 她没能活下来。

sentences.en: She died at nine months of pregnancy at birth.
sentences.zh: 她在怀孕九个月临盆时夭折了。

sentences.en: And it made me who I am.
sentences.zh: 这段经历塑造了今天的我。

sentences.en: I probably would not be here had it not been for that experience.
sentences.zh: 如果没有那段经历，我大概不会站在这里。

sentences.en: It showed me my strength and really put things in perspective for me.
sentences.zh: 它向我展示了我的力量，并真正让我用正确的视角看待事物。

sentences.en: And the doctor said, I need you to understand she's not going to live.
sentences.zh: 医生当时说，我需要你明白她活不长。

sentences.en: But I did understand.
sentences.zh: 我是明白的。

sentences.en: But I was making that choice.
sentences.zh: 但我当时在做那样的选择。

sentences.en: I chose her.
sentences.zh: 我选择了她。

sentences.en: You know, that's such a very personal and painful story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个非常私密且痛苦的故事。

sentences.en: What were you sort of hoping people would understand about you from that?
sentences.zh: 你当时希望人们通过这件事对你有所了解吗？

sentences.en: I think Texans and I think voters want to know, who are you?
sentences.zh: 我认为得克萨斯人和选民都想知道：你是谁？

sentences.en: Why are you doing this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: What motivates you?
sentences.zh: 是什么在驱动着你？

sentences.en: So it was a formative part of my life, formative experience in my life.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我生命中具有决定性的一部分，是我人生中具有塑造意义的经历。

sentences.en: And I think the thing that I wanted to communicate is that this is first and foremost a human experience.
sentences.zh: 我想传达的是，这首先也是最重要的一点，是一种人类的经历。

sentences.en: We have so politicized pregnancy in this country.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，我们把怀孕高度政治化了。

sentences.en: But there are so many women, so many families who have had their hearts broken by pregnancies gone bad.
sentences.zh: 但有太多的女性、太多的家庭，因妊娠不幸而心碎。

sentences.en: And to try to connect with people at a human level with what my human hardship was and how it made me stronger.
sentences.zh: 我希望能从人性的层面与人们建立连接，分享我所遭受的人性苦难以及它是如何让我变得更坚强的。

sentences.en: Do you see abortion as a cultural war issue?
sentences.zh: 你将堕胎视为一场文化战争议题吗？

sentences.en: Do you see it as something that transcends that, as an issue of health care, as an issue of human rights?
sentences.zh: 你是否认为它超越了这一点，将其视为一个医疗保健议题、一个属于人权的议题？

sentences.en: I do think it is an issue of human rights.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为这是一个关于人权的议题。

sentences.en: I do think it is a health care issue.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为这是一个医疗保健议题。

sentences.en: There are women who are dying in Texas because they can't terminate a pregnancy when they are in crisis.
sentences.zh: 在得克萨斯州，有女性因为在遭遇危机时无法终止妊娠而失去生命。

sentences.en: Because doctors are facing 99 years in prison if they terminate a pregnancy to try to save a woman's life.
sentences.zh: 因为医生如果为了挽救女性生命而实施堕胎，将面临长达 99 年的监禁。

sentences.en: And then they're overruled by a political board and women are dying.
sentences.zh: 然后他们的决定又会被一个政治委员会推翻，导致女性不断死亡。

sentences.en: We just had our governor delay the release of the maternal mortality report in the state until after the election.
sentences.zh: 我们的州长刚刚推迟了该州孕产妇死亡率报告的发布，直到选举结束之后。

sentences.en: But we know we've heard so many stories of women dying and we know it's going to be bad.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，我们听到了太多女性死亡的故事，而且我们知道情况会很糟糕。

sentences.en: So absolutely, it is all of those things.
sentences.zh: 所以毫无疑问，它包含了所有这些方面。

sentences.en: What would you like to do if you're governor on that issue?
sentences.zh: 如果你当选州长，你会在这个议题上做些什么？

sentences.en: Or what would you propose to do?
sentences.zh: 或者你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: Again, understanding that, you know, the legislature is what it is.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，你也知道，立法机关就是那个样子。

sentences.en: I do think that we can come together in a bipartisan way to save women's lives.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为我们可以用两党合作的方式来拯救女性的生命。

sentences.en: And that is the commitment I've made on the campaign trail to prioritize saving women's lives.
sentences.zh: 这也是我在竞选过程中作出的承诺，将优先挽救女性生命。

sentences.en: Obviously, you know, as a woman, you are hoping to appeal to women.
sentences.zh: 很显然，你知道的，作为一名女性，你自然希望能吸引女性选民。

sentences.en: And as you've mentioned, including MAGA women.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才提到的，包括支持MAGA的女性。

sentences.en: And I just looked at the latest Marist poll.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚看了一下最新的马利斯特民调。

sentences.en: And you are ahead with women, but not by much.
sentences.zh: 你在女性选民中领先，但优势不大。

sentences.en: Are you doing well enough with women?
sentences.zh: 你在女性选民中的表现足够好吗？

sentences.en: Do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你有考虑过这个问题吗？

sentences.en: We have, well, the only reason we're winning six major polls out of the last five weeks is because of our strong support from women.
sentences.zh: 我们，呃，过去五周我们在六个主要民调中获胜的唯一原因，就是我们拥有来自女性的强力支持。

sentences.en: And so I feel good about our support with women.
sentences.zh: 所以对于我们在女性群体中的支持率，我感到很乐观。

sentences.en: And, but look, we take no demographic for granted.
sentences.zh: 但是，听着，我们不会把任何一个选民群体视为理所当然。

sentences.en: And we're working, again, to appeal to all Texans.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在努力争取所有德克萨斯州人。

sentences.en: And,
sentences.zh: 并且，

sentences.en: but women from mothers who are concerned about their public schools to women concerned about the health care of their daughters to women concerned about data centers that have come into their community and upending their home life in their communities.
sentences.zh: 但女性——从担心公立学校的母亲，到关心女儿医疗健康的女性，再到担心数据中心涌入社区并颠覆其家庭生活的女性。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全如此。

sentences.en: We've garnered a lot of support from women.
sentences.zh: 我们赢得了女性的大量支持。

sentences.en: A different demographic.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个选民群体。

sentences.en: Prominent Latinos wrote a letter to Democratic leadership, imploring them to give you financial support.
sentences.zh: 杰出的拉丁裔人士写信给民主党领导层，恳请他们给予你资金支持。

sentences.en: And I'm going to quote a little bit of that letter.
sentences.zh: 我来引述信中的一小段。

sentences.en: They said,
sentences.zh: 他们写道：

sentences.en: we are asking you to invest in a competitive race with the largest Latino electorate in the country following an election cycle where Republicans made alarming inroads with Latinos.
sentences.zh: 我们在经历了一个共和党在拉丁裔中取得惊人进展的选举周期后，恳请你们在一个拥有全国最大拉丁裔选民基数的竞争激烈的选场进行投资。

sentences.en: I mean, do you think the National Democrats ignore Latino candidates like you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为全国民主党人忽视了像你这样的拉丁裔候选人吗？

sentences.en: Well, I don't really follow like other races.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我其实不太关注其他竞选。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I would like them to invest in this race.
sentences.zh: 但我希望他们能对这次竞选进行投资。

sentences.en: We have an opportunity of a generation to win here.
sentences.zh: 我们迎来了几十年一遇的获胜机遇。

sentences.en: We've been dealt a phenomenal hand in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我们在德州拿到了一手好牌。

sentences.en: And it would be very helpful to have more national support in this race.
sentences.zh: 如果在这场竞选中能得到更多全国层面的支持，那将非常有帮助。

sentences.en: There are big national stakes in this race.
sentences.zh: 这场竞选在全国范围内事关重大。

sentences.en: We know that Republicans in Austin want to redistrict again in Texas, redraw maps.
sentences.zh: 我们知道奥斯汀的共和党人想在德州再次重新划分选区，重绘地图。

sentences.en: And they have decided to do so next year if they win.
sentences.zh: 如果他们获胜，他们已经决定明年就这样做。

sentences.en: We know there's no Democratic control of Congress when that happens.
sentences.zh: 我们知道到那时国会并非由民主党掌控。

sentences.en: We need a governor in Texas who will veto rigged maps.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个会否决被操纵地图的德州州长。

sentences.en: And I will be that governor.
sentences.zh: 而我就会是那样的州长。

sentences.en: So those are the stakes.
sentences.zh: 这就是利害所在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And again, this is an opportunity of a generation to win in 2026.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是2026年赢得胜利的几十年一遇的机遇。

sentences.en: Yes, Latinos are key to that win number.
sentences.zh: 是的，拉丁裔是达到这个获胜票数关键。

sentences.en: Beto got 64 percent of the Latino vote in 2018.
sentences.zh: 贝托在2018年拿到了64%的拉丁裔选票。

sentences.en: When I get that, I win because there are more of us in the voting population in Texas in 2026.
sentences.zh: 当我拿到这个比例时我就会赢，因为到2026年德州选民人口中会有更多我们这样的人。

sentences.en: And look, this is not the time to be playing small ball, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，现在可不是谨小慎微的时候，对吧？

sentences.en: Everything is on the line in 2026.
sentences.zh: 2026年一切都押上了台面。

sentences.en: And so I think that's what motivates people who are pushing national Democrats to invest in Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是促使那些敦促全国民主党人投资德州的人的动力所在。

sentences.en: Do you think the head of the DGA, the Democratic Governors Association, Andy Beshear, disrespected your candidacy?
sentences.zh: 你认为民主党州长协会DGA的负责人安迪·贝希尔对你的参选不够尊重吗？

sentences.en: Because he was reluctant to inveSt.
sentences.zh: 因为他很不情愿进行投资。

sentences.en: Well, I have a good relationship with him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我和他关系不错。

sentences.en: They did send a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们确实寄了一百万美元。

sentences.en: I'm grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 对此我很感激。

sentences.en: And we welcome more support.
sentences.zh: 我们也欢迎更多的支持。

sentences.en: No disrespect, but a million dollars is not a lot in Texas.
sentences.zh: 无意冒犯，但在德州一百万美元并不算多。

sentences.en: It's such a big state, as you rightly said.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才说的，这是一个如此巨大的州。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: It isn't.
sentences.zh: 确实不多。

sentences.en: It's helpful, right?
sentences.zh: 但也有帮助，对吧？

sentences.en: We have mostly raised—95 percent of our contributions come from small-dollar donations.
sentences.zh: 我们的资金大多是筹集来的——我们95%的捐款来自小额捐赠。

sentences.en: I'm proud of what we've been able to raise.
sentences.zh: 我为我们筹款的能力感到骄傲。

sentences.en: We've raised now over $30 million in this race.
sentences.zh: 我们在这次竞选中已经筹集了超过3000万美元。

sentences.en: But that is people power here in Texas.
sentences.zh: 但这就是德州的人民力量。

sentences.en: You just mentioned this issue that is so important, right, which is that Texas is forecasted to add four congressional seats in 2030, and they're planning to redraw the maps,
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了这个非常重要的问题，对吧，也就是预计德州将在2030年增加四个国会席位，而他们正计划重绘地图，

sentences.en: which, you know, could be very, very problematic for Democrats in Congress.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这可能会给国会民主党人带来非常非常大的麻烦。

sentences.en: Did you make the case to the National Party about that?
sentences.zh: 你向全国党组织提及过这件事吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I did make that case, and I have made that case from the very beginning, and we've been talking to anybody who will listen about them from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实提过，而且从一开始我就在提，从一开始我们就一直在跟任何愿意听的人谈论此事。

sentences.en: And so, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，

sentences.en: that's why I think you're hearing Democrats across the country really want to make sure we have the investment we need to win because the stakes are so high and because the opportunity to win is even higher.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为你会听到全国各地的民主党人都非常希望确保我们拥有获胜所需的投资，因为利害关系太重大了，而且获胜的机会甚至更高。

sentences.en: So, like, we've just never had an opportunity like this in—look, we have, for the first time, a ticket running in Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像我们从来没有过这样的机会——听着，我们破天荒地在德州推出了一整套候选人阵容。

sentences.en: We've had Beto in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们过去有过贝托。

sentences.en: We've had Colin Allred in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们过去有过科林·奥尔雷德。

sentences.en: But it was them.
sentences.zh: 但以前只有他们单打独斗。

sentences.en: And now we have me.
sentences.zh: 现在有了我。

sentences.en: We have James.
sentences.zh: 有了詹姆斯。

sentences.en: We have Democrats running up and down the ballot for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我们有民主党人破天荒地在选票上下全面参选。

sentences.en: We have Democrats running in every Texas House seat, Texas Senate seat, congressional seat.
sentences.zh: 我们在德州每一个众议院席位、参议院席位、国会席位都有民主党人参选。

sentences.en: Democrats are working it in every corner of the state up and down the ballot.
sentences.zh: 民主党人正在该州每一个角落的选票上下努力拼搏。

sentences.en: But so, yes, we have an opportunity of a generation, really, to win in Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们在德州确实迎来了真正意义上几十年一遇的获胜机遇。

sentences.en: If you lose, do you think it's the Democratic Party that's to blame, that they should have invested in you more and much earlier?
sentences.zh: 如果你输了，你认为该怪民主党吗？他们本该更早、更多地投资你吗？

sentences.en: Or does a loss ultimately just reflect the heartbreak of Texas for Democrats?
sentences.zh: 还是说失败终究只是反映了民主党人在德州的悲情？

sentences.en: That's—Lulu, so when you're running for governor and you spent a year of your life in the trenches every day running, you can't go into an election thinking, what if I lose?
sentences.zh: 那是——露露，当你竞选州长并且花了一年时间每天都在一线拼搏时，你不能带着“万一我输了怎么办”的想法去选举。

sentences.en: So I can't even contemplate that reality.
sentences.zh: 所以我甚至无法去设想那种现实。

sentences.en: I am running to win.
sentences.zh: 我参选是为了赢。

sentences.en: I think I will win.
sentences.zh: 我认为我会赢。

sentences.en: And we are working to win.
sentences.zh: 我们正在为胜利而努力。

sentences.en: Well, let's say you do win.
sentences.zh: 好吧，假设你真的赢了。

sentences.en: It will be a political earthquake.
sentences.zh: 那将是一场政治地震。

sentences.en: What do you think it will signify?
sentences.zh: 你认为这象征着什么？

sentences.en: You know, the thing that I am most excited about when I win is the feeling Texans will feel to know their power, to know their power again,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我获胜时，最让我兴奋的是德州人将重新感受到他们的力量，重新认识到他们的力量，

sentences.en: to know that we can go up against big money, probably the biggest in the country, entrenched politics.
sentences.zh: 知道我们能够对抗大资本（可能是全国最大的资本）以及根深蒂固的政治势力。

sentences.en: Greg Abbott's—Greg Abbott's the most entrenched incumbent there is probably in America, and that we can win.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·阿博特——格雷格·阿博特可能是全美国根基最深的在任官员，而我们能够战胜他。

sentences.en: And I just know there's going to be this feeling of almost liberation when we feel our power again.
sentences.zh: 我就是知道，当我们重新感受到自己的力量时，将会有一种近乎解放的感觉。

sentences.en: And that's the thing I'm most looking forward to.
sentences.zh: 那是我最期待的事情。

sentences.en: Gina Hinojosa, thank you so much for talking to me.
sentences.zh: 吉娜·伊诺霍萨，非常感谢你接受我的采访。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，露露。

sentences.en: That's Texas State Representative and Gubernatorial Candidate Gina Hinojosa.
sentences.zh: 这位是德克萨斯州州议员兼州长候选人吉娜·伊诺霍萨。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家一样舒适的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们爱喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
